goal: improve exact original character-span Micro F1; 95 percent is a target, not an acceptance condition

training.selection: raw-dev Micro at threshold0, parent epoch0, live and EMA after each epoch

analysis.folds: fixed sha256(text) halves from v2-v9; no re-splitting
analysis.calibration: same train-only gazetteer and six v9 features per model; type intercepts min_support200; GP/boundary-logprob interaction min_support500; base ridge10 and type-slope ridge50; use fitting-partition statistics only
analysis.route_selection: fit-partition exact Micro, then Macro13, then prefer baseline, then fewer models; never select a route using the held-out partition
analysis.adoption: full-dev Micro >= v9; nested crossfit Micro > v9; neither held-out half lower than its v9 selected pipeline

interpretation: exploratory dev comparison after repeated checkpoint/model selection; no independent-test or significance claim
